notes:
Settings tabs, playlist editing and Playing from.
- Settings now has tabs: Preferences, Account, Security, Streaming and About
- Edit your playlists with the gear on their page: cover art, title, description, public or private
- Right-click to remove a song from your playlist, or from Liked Songs on your Likes
- Right-click the playing song to go to the playlist, album or likes it's playing from (works in Link Up too)
- Link Up: the panel sits beside the page, drag songs like the For You organizer, right-click for the song menu, and a playlist's play button sends the whole playlist
- Playlists page shows playlists and albums separately, most recently played first
- Click who reposted a song in your feed to open their profile
- Sidebar items fade between colors, and the SoundCloud logo glows and wiggles when you hover it
